# Rathinam International Public School (RPS)

> Rathinam International Public School (RPS) is a CBSE-affiliated (Affiliation No. 1930977) senior secondary, co-educational school in Eachanari, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. Operated by the Rathinam Group of Institutions, RPS educates children from the Foundation Stage (Nursery) through Senior Secondary (Grade 12) with a holistic, future-ready approach that blends academics, positive psychology, AI & robotics learning (through an Atal Tinkering Lab), sports and the arts.

## Key facts

- School: Rathinam International Public School (RPS), "The Joy of Learning"
- Board: CBSE — Senior Secondary; Affiliation Number 1930977
- Location: Rathinam Techzone Campus, Eachanari, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641021, India
- Phone: +91 8144 260 260
- Email: rpsadmissions@rathinam.in
- Admissions: Open for Academic Year 2026–27
- Academic journey (five stages): Foundation Stage (Nursery–Grade 2), Preparatory Stage (Grades 3–5), Middle School (Grades 6–8), Secondary (Grades 9–10), Senior Secondary (Grades 11–12)

- [Teaching Methods](https://rathinamschool.ac.in/teaching-method): Research-based, experiential, art-integrated, game-based, project-based and blended learning.
- [Facilities](https://rathinamschool.ac.in/facilities): AC classrooms, sports facilities, auditorium, swimming pool, GPS-tracked transport and science laboratories.

- [Post-School Activities](https://rathinamschool.ac.in/post-school-activities): Sports, specialized coaching and the zonal-to-national competition pathway.
- [Celebrations](https://rathinamschool.ac.in/celebrations): Color Day, Culmination Day, Sports Day, Annual Day and festivities.
- [Career Counselling](https://rathinamschool.ac.in/career-counselling): Early awareness, personalized guidance, academic planning and field trips.
- [Guest Lectures](https://rathinamschool.ac.in/guest-lectures): Experts from diverse fields connecting classroom learning to the real world.
- [Career](https://rathinamschool.ac.in/career): Current job openings at RPS.
- [Contact](https://rathinamschool.ac.in/contact): Address, phone, email, map and enquiry form.
